_comment: Hand-curated fallback for steam_events.py, used when the official page cannot be read or parsed. Every dated item was read on partner.steamgames.com on read_on; items with status DA VERIFICARE have no published date: their 'pattern' says what usually happens, never an exact day. Update this file when Valve publishes new dates (steam_events.py fetch prints what changed).

rules.seasonal_sale_eligibility: Any game released at least 30 days before the event start date can join with a discount (upcoming_events, read 2026-10-17). Discounting rules: no discount for 30 days after release (Early Access and full release), except the launch discount; seasonal sales are exempt only from the 30-day discount cooldown, not from the release cooldown (doc/marketing/discounts, read 2026-10-17).
rules.themed_fest_registration: Games are auto-selected by tags and store page and invited by email; partners usually have six weeks or more to register; the opt-in for marketing materials and the discount deadline are typically 6 weeks before the event start; exact dates are on each event page (doc/marketing/upcoming_events/themed_sales, read 2026-10-17). Discounted games are featured most; Coming Soon games and demos get their own sections; playtests are not included.
rules.next_fest_eligibility: Unreleased games with a public store page and a publicly playable demo when the fest begins, released after the fest ends; a game can appear in only one Next Fest ever (doc/marketing/upcoming_events/nextfest and edition pages, read 2026-10-17). Demo for review 5 weeks before the fest for the press preview, 3 weeks before for the fest itself. The first days are randomized, then personalized by player behaviour.
